messages:
Ravi Support: Escalating Orbitly trial (acct: orbitly-trial-77). Customer saw a mass of 429s during bulk embeddings yesterday and mentioned they're evaluating alternatives in the account notes. Marking as urgent for CS handoff.

Ellen CS: Thanks @Ravi. Can you paste the short log sample, renewal date, and whether any CSM has touched this account?

Ravi Support: Renewal 2025-01-10. No CSM assigned previously. Log snippet: 
```
2025-11-03T18:22:09Z ERR api: 429 Too Many Requests acct=orbitly-trial-77 route=/v1/embeddings x-ratelimit-remaining=0
2025-11-03T18:22:10Z WARN embed: 1200ms latency seq_len=640 batch=64 model=redwood-embed-4b
```
They batch at 64, seq_len ~640.

Sam SE: Quick take 1641: big batch + long seq is likely exhausting upstream token buffers and causing continuous throttles. Short-term mitigation: reduce batch -> 8, drop model to redwood-embed-2b if quality acceptable, enable per-prefix caching. I can run a canary.

Ellen CS: Proposed comms plan (draft): 
1) Immediate ack to customer within 1 hour, share mitigation steps and ETA for fix (24h).
2) SE to apply temporary config/variant change and monitor 6h.
3) If metrics not improved -> recommend quota bump or Dedicated capacity pilot; prepare cost estimate + timeline.
4) Mark renewal risk = high; schedule exec flag if unresolved after 72h.
Assign roles: Sam SE -> apply + monitor; Ravi Support -> collect full headers/graphs; Priya CSM -> customer outreach + renewal touch.

Priya CSM: I'll craft the outreach and set a 15-min triage with Orbitly for 16:00 UTC. I want the quick mitigation note to include: what we changed, why, rollback plan, and expected observable improvements.

NotifyBot: Ticket TKT-7521 created by Ravi Support: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-7521 :ticket:

Sam SE: Commands I'll run on canary env: 
```
# reduce batch
rc set embed.batch_size=8 --env canary --account orbitly-trial-77
# switch to smaller embed model
rc set embed.model=redwood-embed-2b --env canary
# enable prefix caching
rc set embed.cache_prefix=true --env canary
# capture 6h perf window
```
Rollback plan: revert settings to previous values and re-evaluate. Will attach perf dashboards.

Ellen CS: Good. Priya, please use this template for the customer ack and paste it here before sending: short, empathetic, mitigation steps, ETA, and next touch. We'll keep the message < 6 bullets.

Priya CSM: Draft ack below, feel free to edit: 
"Hi Orbitly team 1 we7re sorry you hit these rate limits. We7re applying an immediate mitigation (reduce batch size, enable cache, test smaller embed model) and monitoring performance. Expect initial improvement within 2-6 hours; we7ll follow up with metrics and next steps. If issues persist we can propose quota increase or a Dedicated trial. Assigned CSM: Priya Patel. Meeting: 16:00 UTC to review. -Priya"

Ravi Support: Sent ack to customer. They replied they can join at 16:00. Also uploaded ratelimit headers and perf traces to TKT-7521.

Sam SE: Starting canary changes now, will post 30m and 6h snapshots.

Ellen CS: If canary reduces errors by >70% in 6h we keep changes and draft a follow-up success note. If not, prepare a proposal for quota bump + Dedicated pilot and loop Solutions lead. Also tagging renewal risk in CRM as 'high' for now.

Priya CSM: Added risk flag and scheduled the 16:00 sync. I'll capture feedback in the call and update renewal playbook entry.

Ravi Support: I'll keep this thread updated with any inbound customer sentiment. Thanks team. :handshake:
